messages:
jordan: quick proposal: add optional header `X-Embed-UnitHint` so clients can send a best-effort cost hint for an embeddings request (helps routing + console previews).

maya: ok idea. what's the concrete benefit vs we just do server preflight always?

jordan: server preflight is accurate but expensive for big bursts. hint lets ingress make faster routing decisions and show a "predicted cost" in the console before we run heavy checks.

sahil: major risk is bad actors or buggy SDKs sending wrong hints. we should always compute server-side and only use hint when its within a small delta. also emit mismatch telemetry.

lucas: how would the header look in practice? any example?

jordan: example:```http
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-UnitHint: 45
{ "model": "embed-variant-1", "input": [[...], [...]] }
```

jordan: server will compute `X-Embed-Calc` (units) on accept and include it in responses/413s. fallback = bytes->unit heuristic or sample-first-N vectors for big payloads.

maya: console UX: show "client hint / server-calculated units" next to request in request-logs. also surface a "why mismatch" quickhelp.

sahil: rollout plan: phase 1 = accept header but ignore for billing/routing, record telemetry for 14 days. phase 2 = enable hint-as-hint for routing on low-risk tenants. phase 3 = optional enforcement (reject if calc > tenant_softcap * factor).

lucas: Dedicated/private customers? billing rules differ. we should default to telemetry-only there and add an opt-in toggle in the tenant settings.

jordan: agreed. policy defaults: hosted = server-calc authoritative; dedicated = telemetry-only unless opted in.

maya: failure semantics: if server-calc >> hint or > tenant hard limit we should 413 early with headers: `X-Embed-Calc: 123`, `X-Embed-Reason: OVERSIZE` and a body suggesting `use splitter` or `reduce dims`. avoids expensive queueing.

sahil: metrics to add: embed_hint_submitted, embed_hint_mismatch_count, embed_hint_mismatch_pct, preflight_latency_ms, preflight_sample_rate. also track routing decisions: hint_applied, hint_ignored, hint_overridden.

lucas: need trace/span tags so we can connect a mismatch to routing outcome. include hint value, calc value, sampleMethod.

jordan: security note: telemetry must not contain vector contents. only include dims, counts, unit estimates, and a salted request id hash.

maya: docs: include recommended client-side pseudo code for unit calc (table mapping dims->unit + per-request overhead). show gzipped payload caveat.

sahil: edgecases: streaming/chunked embedding uploads. semantics = header is assumed total expected units; on stream end we verify final calc and emit mismatch if necessary. if mismatch > threshold, mark request for follow-up.

jordan: infra: implement fast cheap estimator: bytes->approx-units map + optional sampling for mixed dims. heavy exact calc runs async for audit/billing.

devex-bot: scheduling canary rollout to eng-platform-canary at 1718521300. creating docs issue. :rocket:

maya: console panels: per-tenant mismatch heatmap, top endpoints by avg delta, and a "how to reduce units" card with concrete suggestions.

sahil: add alert when mismatch_ratio > 5% for production tenants.

jordan: next steps: 1) spec header names + response headers, 2) implement estimator and telemetry events, 3) devex mockups + docs snippet, 4) canary telemetry-only, 5) revisit enforcement after two weeks.

maya: I'll mock the console changes and author the docs snippet. tagging @devex-bot to create RF ticket.

devex-bot: created RF-2178: "Embed unit-hint header + console preview" assignees: maya, jordan, sahil.

jordan: thanks all. i'll open a proto + PR for the header names this afternoon. :thumbsup:
